speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the history. To better understand the severity of your symptoms, can you tell me exactly how much weight you have lost over the last few months?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling very tired and have had worsening abdominal pain for about four weeks. I have also had drenching night sweats and lost about twelve pounds.

speaker: Doctor
text: That is significant weight loss. Have you noticed any changes in your bowel habits, such as changes in stool consistency or color, or any blood in your stool?

speaker: Patient
text: I noticed swelling in my neck over the last few days. It does not hurt, but it feels enlarged and fixed.

speaker: Doctor
text: The "fixed" nature of the supraclavicular lymph node combined with your B symptoms is very concerning. Have you experienced any recent fevers, or any history of tuberculosis exposure or smoking? REQUEST TEST: Complete Blood Count with Differential, LDH, and ESR.
